title: Validate-Path Effect-Mode Subsumption (Rand seeded/crypto -> os)
scope_note: Mark's ratification is NARROW: an explicitly declared effect mode subsumes a bare/os requirement in the SubsumeEffectRows VALIDATE path only. Function-value effect-row unification (Unifier.unifyRows -> effectParamsCompatible) stays INVARIANT and must be byte-unchanged in the diff. Only Rand's seeded->os and crypto->os edges are registered. No runtime, replay-label, seed-sourcing, or Clock/Net/FS work.

out_of_scope.out_of_scope_unification: internal/types/unification_records.go:411-441 and effectParamsCompatible (internal/types/effects.go:251-253) must not change. A test proves a ! {Rand[mode=seeded]} function value still fails to unify where ! {Rand} is expected.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_ai_edges: Do NOT register AI subsumption edges (routeable->fixed / replay-only->fixed) even though examples/ai_modes.ail is RED at HEAD with the identical defect. Parked as Q1 for Mark. M2 acceptance asserts the edge table has EXACTLY two entries.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_clock_net_fs: No Clock/Net/FS schema rows, modes, edges, or dispatch. Clock[mode=pinned] still rejects with EFF_PARAMS_NOT_SUPPORTED (verified at HEAD).
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_ci_toplevel_gate: Wiring make verify-examples-toplevel into ci.yml. It is red today on ai_modes.ail, so it is coupled to Q1. Parked as Q2.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_runtime: No changes to internal/eval, internal/effects, internal/replay, rand_seed, AILANG_SEED semantics, or trace schema.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_inference: If preserving full declared rows cannot be confined to internal/pipeline/validate_effects.go plus existing row elaboration and would require a type-INFERENCE change, STOP and file a prerequisite item. Do not widen.

blocking_findings.finding: examples/ai_modes.ail is RED at HEAD with the IDENTICAL defect on the AI effect, so the bug is not Rand-specific and one shipped example is already broken.
blocking_findings.evidence: ./tools/verify_examples.sh exits 1 with exactly one failure: 'TYPE-CHECK FAIL: examples/ai_modes.ail ... lambda at examples/ai_modes.ail:53:8 uses effects not declared in its ! {AI[mode=routeable]} annotation' with an empty Missing effects: payload. summarize_routeable (examples/ai_modes.ail:53) declares ! {AI[mode=routeable]} and calls std/ai.call declared bare ! {AI} (std/ai.ail:418, default mode=fixed).
blocking_findings.consequence: A Rand-only fix leaves ai_modes.ail red. Registering an AI edge would fix it but exceeds the doc's Rand-only instantiation, and internal/types/effects.go:624-626 comments suggest AI invariance may be deliberate.
blocking_findings.handling: PARKED as Q1. Default: Rand-only; document ai_modes.ail as pre-existing red. M2 AC-1 asserts exactly two edges so the executor cannot drift.

blocking_findings.finding: The design doc's acceptance gate 'make verify-examples' does NOT cover examples/modal_rand.ail.
blocking_findings.evidence: make/examples.mk:18-28 runs scripts/verify_examples.go over examples/runnable/ (178 files). modal_rand.ail and ai_modes.ail are top-level examples/*.ail, covered only by make verify-examples-toplevel -> tools/verify_examples.sh. grep -rn verify-examples .github/workflows/ shows ci.yml:216-227 runs only make verify-examples.
blocking_findings.consequence: M3 could report a green gate that never executed the acceptance surface.
blocking_findings.handling: M3 AC-6 requires ./tools/verify_examples.sh explicitly, with its pre-existing ai_modes.ail failure reproduced at the sprint base and documented.

blocking_findings.finding: tools/verify_examples.sh:65 hardcodes 'ailang run --caps IO,FS,Clock,Rand --entry main'. After this fix an os-declared main may not call a seeded/crypto callee, and a seeded-declared main without AILANG_SEED is a loud RAND_SEEDED_NO_SEED error. Also, because seeded and crypto are incomparable, no single function can invoke both.
blocking_findings.consequence: modal_rand.ail cannot demonstrate seeded+crypto from main.
blocking_findings.handling: M3 AC-2: main stays os-only; seeded and crypto get separate entrypoints exercised by a dedicated test.

blocking_findings.finding: UnionEffectRows SILENTLY prefers row 'a' when two rows carry conflicting params for the same effect (internal/types/effects.go:585-598, 'case len(ap) > 0'). Today harmless because callee params are erased; after M1 preserves them, a body calling both a seeded and an os local helper collapses to one mode and the declaration is validated against the survivor.
blocking_findings.consequence: If os survives, an os declaration wrongly ACCEPTS a seeded callee -- reintroducing exactly the hole M1 exists to close. The quorum log recorded this as a non-blocking catch; it is required.
blocking_findings.handling: M1 AC-6 makes multi-mode requirement preservation a hard deliverable with tests in both declaration directions plus source-order independence.

blocking_findings.finding: The 'Suggested fix' line provably echoes the WRONG mode back at the user: validate_effects.go:565 calls types.UnionEffectRows(declared, required) with declared first, which under F4's prefer-'a' merge returns the declared params.
blocking_findings.handling: M2 AC-8: drop the suggestion for mode mismatches or emit the REQUIRED mode.

blocking_findings.finding: ast.EffectNames returns effect-row VARIABLE names as if they were labels, so mapE's declared ! {e} is today a row with a bogus LABEL 'e'. Under ElaborateEffectRowWithBudgets it becomes Labels:{} with Tail:e -- a shape change for 11 stdlib declarations.
blocking_findings.evidence: internal/ast/ast.go:116-123; std/list.ail:217,228,239,250,261 (declared ! {e}); std/stream.ail:100,146,178,237 (declared ! {Stream, e}); std/smoke.ail:43,62 (dispatchAllTools/dispatchTool declared ! {IO | e}, the pipe-tail spelling). They pass today only because the collected requirement is nil.
blocking_findings.handling: M1 AC-5 explicit stdlib row-variable guard, landed before anything else.

blocking_findings.finding: internal/types/effects.go is 720/800 and internal/pipeline/validate_effects.go is 570/800; make check-file-sizes (make/code-health.mk:122-137) is a hard 800-line CI gate.
blocking_findings.handling: M0: new code goes into internal/types/effect_subsumption.go (and internal/pipeline/validate_effects_rows.go if needed), never appended to effects.go.

verified_premises: 9-fixture matrix reproduced EXACTLY at HEAD 54d6bd191 with freshly rebuilt binaries: blocker=1(empty payload), c1=0, c2=1(empty), c3=0, c4=1(Missing effects: Rand), c6=1(empty), c7=0, c8=0, clock=1(EFF_PARAMS_NOT_SUPPORTED). Exit codes read by direct invocation, no pipes. The design doc's 'modes are not currently invariant' correction STANDS.
Exactly 3 production SubsumeEffectRows call sites: internal/pipeline/validate_effects.go:160 (lambda), :221 (LetRec), :245 (Let). EffectRowDifference also at :161 and :542.

Sites :221 and :245 are DOUBLY blind today -- declared is stringSliceToEffectRow(EffectNames(...)) so the DECLARATION's own modes are erased too. That is why every user-visible rejection comes from the lambda site :160.
declaredEffects map[string][]string built with ast.EffectNames at validate_effects.go:110-114; local-callee row rebuilt at :366-373.
Bare Rand normalises to mode=os via effectiveParamsOf (internal/types/effects.go:219-232) and DefaultModeFor (:165-170).

effectSchema is the single source of truth for legal (effect, mode) pairs: internal/types/effects.go:36-48. Rand: os|seeded|crypto. AI: mode fixed|routeable|replay-only, scope byok. Clock/Net/FS have no rows.
Unification is a separate invariant path: Unifier.unifyRows internal/types/unification_records.go:411, param check :427-441 via effectParamsCompatible (effects.go:251-253).
TestSubsumeEffectRows_InvariantOnParams at internal/types/effect_params_test.go:372-394 directly tests SubsumeEffectRows (validate path), NOT unification -- rewrite, do not delete.
types.ElaborateEffectRowWithBudgets exists at internal/types/effects.go:369 and handles params, budgets, min-budgets and row variables; it RETURNS an error for unknown effects and illegal params.

Runtime dispatch already captures and pushes the declared non-os Rand mode: FunctionValue.EffectRandMode (internal/eval/value.go:313) set from extractRandMode (internal/eval/eval_expressions.go:192,199-215).

Seeded runtime source and AILANG_SEED plumbing exist: internal/effects/context.go:497-500 (seedSet), internal/effects/rand_mode_test.go (RAND_SEEDED_NO_SEED is a loud typed error, not a silent fallback).
Replay contract labels unchanged and legal-mode-checked: internal/replay/contracts.go:23-40,67-75.

ValidateEffects callers: internal/pipeline/pipeline_single.go:412 and pipeline_module_compile.go:341 (both pass typeChecker.DeclaredLambdaEffectRow); internal/repl/repl_eval.go:125 passes surfaceAST=nil with no lambda lookup.

Reusable fixture harness: check386 at internal/pipeline/effect_row_show_interp_test.go:26-45 runs the FULL module pipeline (Config{RelaxModules:true, NoCache:true}) so 'import std/rand' resolves. compileAndValidateEffects (effect_soundness_test.go:16-39) does NOT resolve imports and is insufficient for blocker/c1/c2/c6.
Go source tree is clean at HEAD: git diff --stat HEAD -- '*.go' 'go.mod' 'go.sum' 'Makefile' is empty; the -dirty version suffix is only docs/static/benchmarks/*.json.

milestones.name: Validate-only asymmetric subsumption + structured mode diagnostics
milestones.description: Register Rand's seeded->os and crypto->os subsumption edges alongside effectSchema and have SubsumeEffectRows consult them for the mode key only. All other parameter keys stay invariant; a non-default required mode never passes against a different mode; unregistered modes get no fallback. Replace the label-only EffectRowDifference at both diagnostic sites with a structured difference reporting effect, key, required value and declared value.

open_questions_for_human: Q1 (scope): examples/ai_modes.ail is RED at HEAD with the IDENTICAL defect on the AI effect -- summarize_routeable (examples/ai_modes.ail:53) declared ! {AI[mode=routeable]} calls std/ai.call declared bare ! {AI} (= mode=fixed) and is rejected with the same empty 'Missing effects:'. Should this sprint ALSO register AI's routeable->fixed (and replay-only->fixed?) subsumption edges -- which would fix a shipped example that is broken today -- or does AI keep invariant behaviour, leaving ai_modes.ail red until a separate item?
